Gemma dataset 51180 'SZBDMulti-Seq' holds RUZICKA 2024's McLean cohort donors (the Gemma dataset name is Emani's label for that cohort in Data S1; Gemma's own dataset title is 'Single-cell multi-cohort dissection of the schizophrenia transcriptome' — Ruzicka's paper; 72 samples; 11 donors also in Gemma's Ling-2024 dataset). Gemma dataset 51181 'MultiomeBrain' holds brainSCOPE's MultiomeBrain subset (Emani 2024, science.adi5199; 21 samples, 6 SZ / 5 control, bank not stated). Gemma dataset 'CMC' holds brainSCOPE's CommonMind samples (Emani's copy of CMC donors). In this manifest the SZBDMulti-Seq and CMC result sets are attached to BOTH Emani's and Ruzicka's pmids (they were extracted from Emani's paper and Gemma loads them per dataset); they are reanalysis result sets of Ruzicka's donors either way and are not population members (single-gene cell-type sets, and Emani 2024 is role=reanalysis as of 2026-10-03). The MultiomeBrain result sets belong to Emani only.
